items.title: Govt slashes petrol price by Rs8 per litre, high-speed diesel by Rs7 in another reduction
items.summary: The government on Tuesday slashed the price of petrol by Rs8 per litre and that of high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs7. Following the revision, petrol will retail at Rs338 per litre, while HSD will cost Rs371 on Nov 11 (Wednesday), according to a notification by the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (Ogra). The government continues to levy Rs114 per litre in taxes
